data.title: Opera Grand
data.about:
Find your next home in the most coveted address: the Opera Grand by Emaar. Located in the flourishing cultural hub of Dubai Opera District, these homes offer you the option of 1 to 5 bedroom apartments and 5 bedroom townhouses. The beautiful homes have the best views of the iconic city skyline.

Wake up to the front-row seats of the Dubai Fountains and just steps away from the Dubai Mall and Burj Khalifa. Residents will enjoy the creme-de-la-creme of retail, dining and fashion outlets. Not just that, they will also have access to the exclusive amenities offered by Emaar. If you love living the Grand lifestyle, this is the home for you.
